AnoleFinder

Anolis species recorded within a set distance from a point. Localities are from Poe (2025; Guide to the Anolis Lizards [Anoles] of Mainland Central and South America). Original vetted sources include GBIF, iNat, BIOWEB Ecuador, Ribeiro-Junior (2015), Velasco et al. (2020).

or click the map to set the point

Decimal degrees; south and west are negative. You can paste “10.75, -69.72” into Latitude.
